The deep discount, low absolute price, generous size and strong MRT access make this a value-led entry, with 4.2%/yr appreciation and ~78 years of lease remaining.

A $1.6M, 1,625sqft 3BR squarely in the liquid band, 490m from Aljunied EW MRT, in the Paya Lebar Central catchment, with ~78 years of lease left (2004 build) and 4.2%/yr appreciation. The high score_1000 (833) and undefeated-on-draws arena record reinforce the value case. A solid Buy at this discount.

history.summary: Verified-cheap large 3BR ~280m from Aljunied MRT, but a 22-year-old 99LH with lease decay capping a 5-7yr exit.
history.rating_rationale: Asking $984.62 psf is genuinely below the verified recent band ($905-$1,183 psf, avg ~$1,111), so the very_low_psf flag is a real bargain not a mis-scrape; the size (1,625 sqft) explains part of the PSF gap. age_adj_premium -37.8% confirms it screens cheap for its age, and D14 is a favorable OCR/RCR forward region with Aljunied MRT just ~280m away. Two real drags lower conviction: psf_cohort_txns is 0 (no same-size comp at all, so the cohort discount is unverified) and at built-2004 the 99LH has ~77 years left and decay accelerates over a 5-7yr hold, capping upside. The bargain is real but the lease and thin cohort keep this a low-confidence Buy.

psf_cohort_txns = 0: no same-size transaction to verify the cohort discount
Geylang/Lorong 27A locale (older neighbourhood, some buyer aversion)
catalysts: Verified below-market PSF vs recent resales gives a real value cushion
